scenicChapters.title: Stadhuis met Toren → Voormalig Stadhuis / Lakenhal

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 25 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

It goes by way of The Water-bringing system of Peterhof, The Palace and Park Ensemble of the Villag, Dudergof and back through The Palace and Park Ensemble of the Villag. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
